name: LagTwoPositivity.hd_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem hd_nil : hd [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.hd_cons
statement: @[simp] theorem hd_cons : hd (v :: r) = v
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.tl_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem tl_nil {α : Type _} : tl ([] : List α) = []
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.tl_cons
statement: @[simp] theorem tl_cons {α : Type _} {u : α} {s : List α} : tl (u :: s) = s
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.Q_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem Q_nil : Q a b c [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.Q_cons
statement:
theorem Q_cons : Q a b c (v :: r)
    = a * (v * v) + b * (v * hd r) + c * (v * hd (tl r)) + Q a b c r
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.Q_cons_sq
statement:
theorem Q_cons_sq : Q a b c (v :: r)
    = a * v ^ 2 + b * (v * hd r) + c * (v * hd (tl r)) + Q a b c r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q_cons]
  simp [Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_zero, Int.one_mul]

name: LagTwoPositivity.iso_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem iso_nil : iso [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.iso_cons
statement:
theorem iso_cons : iso (v :: r)
    = (if hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r) then v * hd (tl r) else 0) + iso r
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.blocks_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem blocks_nil : blocks [] = []
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qblocks_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem Qblocks_nil : Qblocks a b c [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.nonneg_hd
statement: theorem nonneg_hd (h : Nonneg x) : 0 ≤ hd x
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nil => simp
  | cons u s => exact h.1

name: LagTwoPositivity.nonneg_tail
statement: theorem nonneg_tail (h : Nonneg (v :: r)) : Nonneg r

name: LagTwoPositivity.nonneg_tl
statement: theorem nonneg_tl (h : Nonneg x) : Nonneg (tl x)
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons u s => exact h.2

name: LagTwoPositivity.nonneg_iff_forall_mem
statement: theorem nonneg_iff_forall_mem : ∀ x : List Int, Nonneg x ↔ ∀ v ∈ x, 0 ≤ v
proof:
| [] => by simp [Nonneg]
  | v :: r => by
      simp only [Nonneg, List.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp]
      rw [nonneg_iff_forall_mem r]

name: LagTwoPositivity.blocks_cons_nonpos
statement: theorem blocks_cons_nonpos (h : ¬ 0 < v) : blocks (v :: r) = blocks r
proof:
:= by
  simp [blocks, h]

name: LagTwoPositivity.blocks_cons_pos_pos
statement:
theorem blocks_cons_pos_pos (h : 0 < v) (h2 : 0 < hd r) :
    blocks (v :: r) = (v :: (blocks r).headD []) :: (blocks r).tail
proof:
:= by
  simp [blocks, h, h2]

name: LagTwoPositivity.blocks_cons_pos_nonpos
statement:
theorem blocks_cons_pos_nonpos (h : 0 < v) (h2 : ¬ 0 < hd r) :
    blocks (v :: r) = [v] :: blocks r
proof:
:= by
  simp [blocks, h, h2]

name: LagTwoPositivity.blocks_ne_nil
statement: theorem blocks_ne_nil (h : 0 < hd x) : blocks x ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons u s =>
      simp only [hd_cons] at h
      by_cases hs : 0 < hd s
      · rw [blocks_cons_pos_pos h hs]; simp
      · rw [blocks_cons_pos_nonpos h hs]; simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.hd_firstBlock
statement: theorem hd_firstBlock (h : 0 < hd x) : hd ((blocks x).headD []) = hd x
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons u s =>
      simp only [hd_cons] at h
      by_cases hs : 0 < hd s
      · rw [blocks_cons_pos_pos h hs]; simp
      · rw [blocks_cons_pos_nonpos h hs]; simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.hd_tl_firstBlock
statement:
theorem hd_tl_firstBlock (hx : Nonneg x) (h : 0 < hd x) :
    hd (tl ((blocks x).headD [])) = hd (tl x)
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons u s =>
      simp only [hd_cons] at h
      by_cases hs : 0 < hd s
      · rw [blocks_cons_pos_pos h hs]
        simpa using hd_firstBlock hs
      · rw [blocks_cons_pos_nonpos h hs]
        have hge : 0 ≤ hd s := nonneg_hd (nonneg_tail hx)
        have h0 : hd s = 0 := by omega
        simp [h0]

name: LagTwoPositivity.blocks_pos
statement: theorem blocks_pos : ∀ {x : List Int}, ∀ B ∈ blocks x, ∀ u ∈ B, 0 < u
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro B hB; simp at hB
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro B hB u hu
    by_cases hv : 0 < v
    · by_cases hw : 0 < hd r
      · rw [blocks_cons_pos_pos hv hw] at hB
        cases hb : blocks r with
        | nil => exact absurd hb (blocks_ne_nil hw)
        | cons H T =>
          rw [hb] at hB
          simp only [List.headD_cons, List.tail_cons, List.mem_cons] at hB
          rcases hB with rfl | hB
          · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hu with rfl | hu
            · exact hv
            · exact ih H (by rw [hb]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..) u hu
          · exact ih B (by rw [hb]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hB) u hu
      · rw [blocks_cons_pos_nonpos hv hw] at hB
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hB with rfl | hB
        · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hu with rfl | hu
          · exact hv
          · simp at hu
        · exact ih B hB u hu
    · rw [blocks_cons_nonpos hv] at hB
      exact ih B hB u hu

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qblocks_cons_nonpos
statement:
theorem Qblocks_cons_nonpos (h : ¬ 0 < v) :
    Qblocks a b c (v :: r) = Qblocks a b c r
proof:
:= by
  simp [Qblocks, blocks_cons_nonpos h]

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qblocks_cons_pos_nonpos
statement:
theorem Qblocks_cons_pos_nonpos (h : 0 < v) (h2 : ¬ 0 < hd r) :
    Qblocks a b c (v :: r) = a * (v * v) + Qblocks a b c r
proof:
:= by
  simp [Qblocks, blocks_cons_pos_nonpos h h2, Q_cons]

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qblocks_cons_pos_pos
statement:
theorem Qblocks_cons_pos_pos (hr : Nonneg r) (h : 0 < v) (h2 : 0 < hd r) :
    Qblocks a b c (v :: r)
      = a * (v * v) + b * (v * hd r) + c * (v * hd (tl r)) + Qblocks a b c r
proof:
:= by
  have hH := hd_firstBlock (x := r) h2
  have hT := hd_tl_firstBlock (x := r) hr h2
  rw [Qblocks, blocks_cons_pos_pos h h2]
  cases hb : blocks r with
  | nil => exact absurd hb (blocks_ne_nil h2)
  | cons H T =>
      rw [hb] at hH hT
      simp only [List.headD_cons, List.tail_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at *
      rw [Q_cons, hH, hT, Qblocks, hb]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.gd_identity
statement:
theorem gd_identity :
    ∀ x : List Int, Nonneg x → Q a b c x = Qblocks a b c x + c * iso x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro hx
    have hr : Nonneg r := nonneg_tail hx
    have IH := ih hr
    rw [Q_cons, iso_cons]
    by_cases hv : 0 < v
    · by_cases hw : 0 < hd r
      · have hne : ¬ (hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r)) := by
          rintro ⟨h0, -, -⟩; omega
        rw [Qblocks_cons_pos_pos hr hv hw, if_neg hne, Int.zero_add]
        omega
      · have hge : 0 ≤ hd r := nonneg_hd hr
        have h0 : hd r = 0 := by omega
        rw [Qblocks_cons_pos_nonpos hv hw]
        by_cases hz : 0 < hd (tl r)
        · rw [if_pos ⟨h0, hv, hz⟩, h0, Int.mul_add]
          omega
        · have hge2 : 0 ≤ hd (tl r) := nonneg_hd (nonneg_tl hr)
          have h0' : hd (tl r) = 0 := by omega
          have hne : ¬ (hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r)) := by
            rintro ⟨-, -, h⟩; omega
          rw [if_neg hne, h0, h0', Int.zero_add]
          omega
    · have hv0 : v = 0 := by have := hx.1; omega
      have hne : ¬ (hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r)) := by
        rintro ⟨-, h, -⟩; omega
      rw [Qblocks_cons_nonpos hv, if_neg hne, Int.zero_add, hv0]
      omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.isolated_zero_strict
proof:
:= by
  have h := gd_identity a b c x hx
  have hpos : 0 < c * iso x := Int.mul_pos hc hiso
  omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.sharpness_at_zero
statement: theorem sharpness_at_zero : Q a b 0 [1,1,0,1,1] = 2 * Q a b 0 [1,1]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Q_cons, Q_nil, hd_cons, hd_nil, tl_cons, tl_nil]
  omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.gd_identity'
statement:
theorem gd_identity' (x : List Int) (hx : ∀ v ∈ x, 0 ≤ v) :
    Q a b c x = (((blocks x).map (Q a b c)).sum) + c * iso x
proof:
:=
  gd_identity a b c x ((nonneg_iff_forall_mem x).2 hx)

name: LagTwoPositivity.isolated_zero_strict'
statement:
theorem isolated_zero_strict' (x : List Int) (hx : ∀ v ∈ x, 0 ≤ v)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hiso : 0 < iso x) :
    (((blocks x).map (Q a b c)).sum) < Q a b c x
proof:
:=
  isolated_zero_strict a b c ((nonneg_iff_forall_mem x).2 hx) hc hiso

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qblocks_eq
statement:
theorem Qblocks_eq (x : List Int) :
    Qblocks a b c x = ((blocks x).map (Q a b c)).sum
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.cdot_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem cdot_nil : cdot c i L [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.cdot_cons
statement:
theorem cdot_cons {vs : List Int} :
    cdot c i L (v :: vs) = c i L * v + cdot c i (L + 1) vs
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.cdot_eq
statement:
theorem cdot_eq (c : Nat → Nat → Int) (i L : Nat) (r : List Int) :
    cdot c i L r = c i L * hd r + cdot c i (L + 1) (tl r)
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | nil => simp
  | cons u s => rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.zeros_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem zeros_nil : zeros [] = []
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.zeros_cons
statement: @[simp] theorem zeros_cons : zeros (v :: r) = 0 :: zeros r
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.hd_zeros
statement: @[simp] theorem hd_zeros : hd (zeros r) = 0
proof: := by cases r <;> rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.tl_zeros
statement: @[simp] theorem tl_zeros : tl (zeros r) = zeros (tl r)
proof: := by cases r <;> rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.zeros_nonneg
statement: theorem zeros_nonneg : ∀ r : List Int, Nonneg (zeros r)
proof:
| []     => trivial
  | _ :: s => ⟨by omega, zeros_nonneg s⟩

name: LagTwoPositivity.cdot_zeros
statement: @[simp] theorem cdot_zeros : ∀ (r : List Int) (L : Nat), cdot c i L (zeros r) = 0
proof:
| [],     _ => rfl
  | _ :: s, L => by rw [zeros_cons, cdot_cons, cdot_zeros s (L + 1)]; simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qfrom_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem Qfrom_nil : Qfrom c i [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qfrom_cons
statement:
theorem Qfrom_cons :
    Qfrom c i (v :: r) = c i 0 * (v * v) + v * cdot c i 1 r + Qfrom c (i + 1) r
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qfrom_cons_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem Qfrom_cons_zero {B : List Int} : Qfrom c i (0 :: B) = Qfrom c (i + 1) B
proof:
:= by
  rw [Qfrom_cons]; simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qfrom_zeros
statement: @[simp] theorem Qfrom_zeros : ∀ (r : List Int) (i : Nat), Qfrom c i (zeros r) = 0
proof:
| [],     _ => rfl
  | _ :: s, i => by rw [zeros_cons, Qfrom_cons_zero, Qfrom_zeros s (i + 1)]

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qf_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem Qf_nil : Qf c [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.cdot_of_gt
statement:
theorem cdot_of_gt {K : Nat} (h : Bandwidth c K) (i : Nat) :
    ∀ (s : List Int) (L : Nat), K < L → cdot c i L s = 0
proof:
| [],     _, _  => rfl
  | _ :: t, L, hL => by
      rw [cdot_cons, h i L hL, cdot_of_gt h i t (L + 1) (by omega)]; simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.cdot_band_two
statement:
theorem cdot_band_two (h : Bandwidth c 2) (i : Nat) (r : List Int) :
    cdot c i 1 r = c i 1 * hd r + c i 2 * hd (tl r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cdot_eq c i 1 r, cdot_eq c i 2 (tl r), cdot_of_gt h i (tl (tl r)) 3 (by omega)]
  omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.cdot_band_one
statement:
theorem cdot_band_one (h : Bandwidth c 1) (i : Nat) (r : List Int) :
    cdot c i 1 r = c i 1 * hd r
proof:
:= by
  rw [cdot_eq c i 1 r, cdot_of_gt h i (tl r) 2 (by omega)]
  omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.restr_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem restr_nil : restr [] = []
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.cross_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem cross_nil : cross c i [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.cross_cons
statement:
theorem cross_cons :
    cross c i (v :: r)
      = (if 0 < v then v * (cdot c i 1 r - cdot c i 1 (headRestr r)) else 0)
        + cross c (i + 1) r
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.isoW_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem isoW_nil : isoW c i [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.isoW_cons
statement:
theorem isoW_cons :
    isoW c i (v :: r)
      = (if hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r) then c i 2 * (v * hd (tl r)) else 0)
        + isoW c (i + 1) r
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.mul_left_comm'
statement: theorem mul_left_comm' (u w z : Int) : u * (w * z) = w * (u * z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.mul_assoc, Int.mul_comm u w, Int.mul_assoc]

name: LagTwoPositivity.restr_cons_nonpos
statement:
theorem restr_cons_nonpos (h : ¬ 0 < v) :
    restr (v :: r) = (restr r).map (fun B => (0 : Int) :: B)
proof: := by simp [restr, h]

name: LagTwoPositivity.restr_cons_pos_pos
statement:
theorem restr_cons_pos_pos (h : 0 < v) (h2 : 0 < hd r) :
    restr (v :: r)
      = (v :: (restr r).headD (zeros r)) :: (restr r).tail.map (fun B => (0 : Int) :: B)
proof:
:= by
  simp [restr, h, h2]

name: LagTwoPositivity.restr_cons_pos_nonpos
statement:
theorem restr_cons_pos_nonpos (h : 0 < v) (h2 : ¬ 0 < hd r) :
    restr (v :: r) = (v :: zeros r) :: (restr r).map (fun B => (0 : Int) :: B)
proof:
:= by
  simp [restr, h, h2]

name: LagTwoPositivity.restr_ne_nil
statement: theorem restr_ne_nil (h : 0 < hd x) : restr x ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons u s =>
      simp only [hd_cons] at h
      by_cases hs : 0 < hd s
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_pos h hs]; simp
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_nonpos h hs]; simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.hd_firstRestr
statement: theorem hd_firstRestr (h : 0 < hd x) : hd ((restr x).headD (zeros x)) = hd x
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons u s =>
      simp only [hd_cons] at h
      by_cases hs : 0 < hd s
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_pos h hs]; simp
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_nonpos h hs]; simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.headRestr_of_pos
statement: theorem headRestr_of_pos (h : 0 < hd r) : headRestr r = (restr r).headD (zeros r)
proof:
:= by
  simp [headRestr, h]

name: LagTwoPositivity.headRestr_of_nonpos
statement: theorem headRestr_of_nonpos (h : ¬ 0 < hd r) : headRestr r = zeros r
proof:
:= by
  simp [headRestr, h]

name: LagTwoPositivity.hd_headRestr
statement: theorem hd_headRestr (hr : Nonneg r) : hd (headRestr r) = hd r
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : 0 < hd r
  · rw [headRestr_of_pos h]; exact hd_firstRestr h
  · have hge : 0 ≤ hd r := nonneg_hd hr
    have h0 : hd r = 0 := by omega
    rw [headRestr_of_nonpos h, h0]; simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.hd_tl_headRestr
statement:
theorem hd_tl_headRestr (hr : Nonneg r) (h : 0 < hd r) :
    hd (tl (headRestr r)) = hd (tl r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [headRestr_of_pos h]
  cases r with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons u s =>
      simp only [hd_cons] at h
      by_cases hs : 0 < hd s
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_pos h hs]
        simpa using hd_firstRestr hs
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_nonpos h hs]
        have hge : 0 ≤ hd s := nonneg_hd (nonneg_tail hr)
        have h0 : hd s = 0 := by omega
        simp [h0]

name: LagTwoPositivity.adjacent_same_restr
statement:
theorem adjacent_same_restr (hv : 0 < v) (hw : 0 < hd r) :
    (restr (v :: r)).headD (zeros (v :: r)) = v :: headRestr r ∧ hd (headRestr r) = hd r
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, by rw [headRestr_of_pos hw]; exact hd_firstRestr hw⟩
  rw [restr_cons_pos_pos hv hw, headRestr_of_pos hw]
  simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.sum_map_cons_zero
statement:
theorem sum_map_cons_zero (c : Nat → Nat → Int) (i : Nat) :
    ∀ L : List (List Int),
      ((L.map (fun B => (0 : Int) :: B)).map (Qfrom c i)).sum
        = (L.map (Qfrom c (i + 1))).sum
proof:
| []      => rfl
  | B :: T  => by
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Qfrom_cons_zero]
      rw [sum_map_cons_zero c i T]

name: LagTwoPositivity.gd_identity_posdep
statement:
theorem gd_identity_posdep (c : Nat → Nat → Int) :
    ∀ x : List Int, Nonneg x → ∀ i : Nat,
      Qfrom c i x = ((restr x).map (Qfrom c i)).sum + cross c i x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _ _; simp [cross]
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro hx i
    have hr : Nonneg r := nonneg_tail hx
    have IH := ih hr (i + 1)
    rw [Qfrom_cons, cross_cons]
    by_cases hv : 0 < v
    · by_cases hw : 0 < hd r
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_pos hv hw, if_pos hv, headRestr_of_pos hw]
        cases hb : restr r with
        | nil => exact absurd hb (restr_ne_nil hw)
        | cons H T =>
          rw [hb] at IH
          simp only [List.headD_cons, List.tail_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at IH ⊢
          rw [Qfrom_cons, sum_map_cons_zero c i T, Int.mul_sub]
          omega
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_nonpos hv hw, if_pos hv, headRestr_of_nonpos hw]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
        rw [Qfrom_cons, sum_map_cons_zero c i (restr r), cdot_zeros, Qfrom_zeros,
          Int.sub_zero]
        omega
    · have hv0 : v = 0 := by have := hx.1; omega
      rw [restr_cons_nonpos hv, if_neg hv, hv0, sum_map_cons_zero c i (restr r)]
      simp only [Int.zero_mul, Int.mul_zero, Int.zero_add, Int.add_zero]
      omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.gd_identity_posdep'
statement:
theorem gd_identity_posdep' (c : Nat → Nat → Int) (x : List Int) (hx : Nonneg x) :
    Qf c x = ((restr x).map (Qf c)).sum + cross c 0 x
proof:
:=
  gd_identity_posdep c x hx 0

name: LagTwoPositivity.straddle_lag_ge_two
statement:
theorem straddle_lag_ge_two (c : Nat → Nat → Int) (i : Nat) (hr : Nonneg r) :
    cdot c i 1 r - cdot c i 1 (headRestr r)
      = cdot c i 2 (tl r) - cdot c i 2 (tl (headRestr r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cdot_eq c i 1 r, cdot_eq c i 1 (headRestr r), hd_headRestr hr,
    show (1 : Nat) + 1 = 2 from rfl]
  omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.cross_eq_zero_of_band_one
statement:
theorem cross_eq_zero_of_band_one (h : Bandwidth c 1) :
    ∀ x : List Int, Nonneg x → ∀ i : Nat, cross c i x = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _ _; rfl
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro hx i
    have hr : Nonneg r := nonneg_tail hx
    rw [cross_cons, ih hr (i + 1),
        cdot_band_one h i r, cdot_band_one h i (headRestr r), hd_headRestr hr]
    simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.cross_eq_isoW
statement:
theorem cross_eq_isoW (h : Bandwidth c 2) :
    ∀ x : List Int, Nonneg x → ∀ i : Nat, cross c i x = isoW c i x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _ _; rfl
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro hx i
    have hr : Nonneg r := nonneg_tail hx
    rw [cross_cons,
        isoW_cons,
        ih hr (i + 1)]
    by_cases hv : 0 < v
    · by_cases hw : 0 < hd r
      · have hH : hd (headRestr r) = hd r := hd_headRestr hr
        have hT : hd (tl (headRestr r)) = hd (tl r) := hd_tl_headRestr hr hw
        have hne : ¬ (hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r)) := by rintro ⟨h0, -, -⟩; omega
        rw [if_pos hv, if_neg hne, cdot_band_two h i r, cdot_band_two h i (headRestr r),
          hH, hT]
        simp
      · have hge : 0 ≤ hd r := nonneg_hd hr
        have h0 : hd r = 0 := by omega
        rw [if_pos hv, headRestr_of_nonpos hw, cdot_band_two h i r,
          cdot_band_two h i (zeros r), hd_zeros, tl_zeros, hd_zeros, h0]
        simp only [Int.mul_zero, Int.zero_add, Int.add_zero, Int.sub_zero, true_and]
        by_cases hz : 0 < hd (tl r)
        · rw [if_pos ⟨hv, hz⟩, mul_left_comm' v (c i 2) (hd (tl r))]
        · have hge2 : 0 ≤ hd (tl r) := nonneg_hd (nonneg_tl hr)
          have h0' : hd (tl r) = 0 := by omega
          have hne : ¬ (0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r)) := by rintro ⟨-, hcon⟩; omega
          rw [if_neg hne, h0']
          simp
    · rw [if_neg hv]
      have hne : ¬ (hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r)) := by rintro ⟨-, hcon, -⟩; omega
      rw [if_neg hne]

name: LagTwoPositivity.gd_identity_band_two
statement:
theorem gd_identity_band_two (h : Bandwidth c 2) (x : List Int) (hx : Nonneg x) :
    Qf c x = ((restr x).map (Qf c)).sum + isoW c 0 x
proof:
:= by
  rw [gd_identity_posdep' c x hx, cross_eq_isoW h x hx 0]

name: LagTwoPositivity.iso_nonneg
statement: theorem iso_nonneg : ∀ x : List Int, Nonneg x → 0 ≤ iso x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro hx
    have := ih (nonneg_tail hx)
    rw [iso_cons]
    by_cases h : hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r)
    · rw [if_pos h]
      have : 0 < v * hd (tl r) := Int.mul_pos h.2.1 h.2.2
      omega
    · rw [if_neg h]; omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.isoW_nonneg
statement:
theorem isoW_nonneg (hc2 : ∀ i, 0 < c i 2) :
    ∀ x : List Int, Nonneg x → ∀ i : Nat, 0 ≤ isoW c i x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _ _; exact Int.le_refl 0
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro hx i
    have IH := ih (nonneg_tail hx) (i + 1)
    rw [isoW_cons]
    by_cases h : hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r)
    · rw [if_pos h]
      have : 0 < c i 2 * (v * hd (tl r)) := Int.mul_pos (hc2 i) (Int.mul_pos h.2.1 h.2.2)
      omega
    · rw [if_neg h]; omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.isoW_pos
statement:
theorem isoW_pos (hc2 : ∀ i, 0 < c i 2) :
    ∀ x : List Int, Nonneg x → ∀ i : Nat, 0 < iso x → 0 < isoW c i x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _ _ h; simp at h
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro hx i hpos
    have hr : Nonneg r := nonneg_tail hx
    have IHnn : 0 ≤ isoW c (i + 1) r := isoW_nonneg hc2 r hr (i + 1)
    rw [isoW_cons]
    by_cases h : hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r)
    · rw [if_pos h]
      have : 0 < c i 2 * (v * hd (tl r)) := Int.mul_pos (hc2 i) (Int.mul_pos h.2.1 h.2.2)
      omega
    · rw [if_neg h, Int.zero_add]
      rw [iso_cons, if_neg h, Int.zero_add] at hpos
      exact ih hr (i + 1) hpos

name: LagTwoPositivity.isoW_eq_zero_of_iso_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isoW_eq_zero_of_iso_eq_zero :
    ∀ x : List Int, Nonneg x → ∀ i : Nat, iso x = 0 → isoW c i x = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _ _ _; rfl
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro hx i h0
    have hr : Nonneg r := nonneg_tail hx
    have hnn : 0 ≤ iso r := iso_nonneg r hr
    rw [iso_cons] at h0
    have hcond : ¬ (hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r)) := by
      intro h
      rw [if_pos h] at h0
      have : 0 < v * hd (tl r) := Int.mul_pos h.2.1 h.2.2
      omega
    rw [if_neg hcond, Int.zero_add] at h0
    rw [isoW_cons, if_neg hcond, Int.zero_add, ih hr (i + 1) h0]

name: LagTwoPositivity.toep_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem toep_zero (i : Nat) : toep a b c i 0 = a
proof: := by simp [toep]

name: LagTwoPositivity.toep_one
statement: @[simp] theorem toep_one (i : Nat) : toep a b c i 1 = b
proof: := by simp [toep]

name: LagTwoPositivity.toep_two
statement: @[simp] theorem toep_two (i : Nat) : toep a b c i 2 = c
proof: := by simp [toep]

name: LagTwoPositivity.toep_band
statement: theorem toep_band : Bandwidth (toep a b c) 2
proof:
:= by
  intro i L h
  simp only [toep]
  rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qfrom_toep
statement: theorem Qfrom_toep : ∀ (x : List Int) (i : Nat), Qfrom (toep a b c) i x = Q a b c x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _; rfl
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro i
    rw [Qfrom_cons, ih (i + 1), cdot_band_two (toep_band a b c) i r, Q_cons,
      toep_zero, toep_one, toep_two, Int.mul_add,
      mul_left_comm' v b (hd r), mul_left_comm' v c (hd (tl r))]
    omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qf_toep
statement: theorem Qf_toep (x : List Int) : Qf (toep a b c) x = Q a b c x
proof: := Qfrom_toep a b c x 0

name: LagTwoPositivity.isoW_toep
statement: theorem isoW_toep : ∀ (x : List Int) (i : Nat), isoW (toep a b c) i x = c * iso x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro i
    rw [isoW_cons,
      ih (i + 1), iso_cons, Int.mul_add, toep_two]
    by_cases h : hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r)
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]; simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.gd_identity_restr
statement:
theorem gd_identity_restr (x : List Int) (hx : Nonneg x) :
    Q a b c x = ((restr x).map (Q a b c)).sum + c * iso x
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : Qf (toep a b c) = Q a b c := funext (Qf_toep a b c)
  have h := gd_identity_band_two (toep_band a b c) x hx
  rw [isoW_toep a b c x 0, hfun] at h
  exact h

name: LagTwoPositivity.Qblocks_eq_Qrestr
statement:
theorem Qblocks_eq_Qrestr (x : List Int) (hx : Nonneg x) :
    Qblocks a b c x = ((restr x).map (Q a b c)).sum
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := gd_identity a b c x hx
  have h2 := gd_identity_restr a b c x hx
  omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.mul_le_nine
statement: theorem mul_le_nine {p q : Int} (hp : p ≤ 3) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq : q ≤ 3) : p * q ≤ 9
proof:
:= by
  have := Int.mul_le_mul hp hq hq0 (by omega)
  omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.iso_pair_bound
statement:
theorem iso_pair_bound :
    ∀ x : List Int, Nonneg x → (∀ v ∈ x, v ≤ 3) →
      (x ≠ [] → 2 * iso x + 9 ≤ 9 * (x.length : Int)) ∧
      (tl x ≠ [] → 2 * iso (tl x) + 9 ≤ 9 * ((tl x).length : Int))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _ _; exact ⟨fun h => absurd rfl h, fun h => absurd rfl h⟩
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro hx hb
    have hr : Nonneg r := nonneg_tail hx
    have hbr : ∀ w ∈ r, w ≤ 3 := fun w hw => hb w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw)
    obtain ⟨IH1, IH2⟩ := ih hr hbr
    refine ⟨fun _ => ?_, fun h => IH1 (by simpa using h)⟩
    rw [iso_cons]
    by_cases hc : hd r = 0 ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < hd (tl r)
    · rw [if_pos hc]
      have h0 := hc.1
      have hsp := hc.2.2
      cases r with
      | nil => simp at hsp
      | cons u s =>
        cases s with
        | nil => simp at hsp
        | cons w s' =>
          simp only [hd_cons, tl_cons] at h0 hsp ⊢
          have hIH := IH2 (by simp)
          simp only [tl_cons] at hIH
          
          have hisor : iso (u :: w :: s') = iso (w :: s') := by
            rw [iso_cons, if_neg (by rintro ⟨-, hcon, -⟩; omega), Int.zero_add]
          have hvw : v * w ≤ 9 :=
            mul_le_nine (hb v (List.mem_cons_self ..)) (by omega)
              (hb w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self ..))))
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hIH ⊢
          omega
    · rw [if_neg hc]
      by_cases hrnil : r = []
      · subst hrnil; simp
      · have hI := IH1 hrnil
        have hnn := iso_nonneg r hr
        simp only [List.length_cons]
        omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.iso_le_27
statement:
theorem iso_le_27 (x : List Int) (hx : Nonneg x) (hb : ∀ v ∈ x, v ≤ 3)
    (hlen : x.length ≤ 7) : iso x ≤ 27
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nil => simp
  | cons v r =>
    have h := (iso_pair_bound (v :: r) hx hb).1 (by simp)
    have hl : (v :: r).length ≤ 7 := hlen
    omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.defect_eq_iso
statement: theorem defect_eq_iso (x : List Int) (hx : Nonneg x) : defect x = -100 * iso x
proof:
:= by
  have := gd_identity 4369 (-6314) (-100) x hx
  simp only [defect]
  omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.defect_ge_neg_2700
statement:
theorem defect_ge_neg_2700 (x : List Int) (hx : Nonneg x) (hb : ∀ v ∈ x, v ≤ 3)
    (hlen : x.length ≤ 7) : -2700 ≤ defect x
proof:
:= by
  have hid := defect_eq_iso x hx
  have h27 := iso_le_27 x hx hb hlen
  have hnn := iso_nonneg x hx
  omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.defect_attained
proof:
:=
  ⟨(nonneg_iff_forall_mem _).2 (by decide), by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

name: LagTwoPositivity.Masked_nil_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem Masked_nil_nil : Masked [] []
proof: := trivial

name: LagTwoPositivity.Masked_cons
statement:
theorem Masked_cons {w v : Int} {ws vs : List Int} :
    Masked (w :: ws) (v :: vs) ↔ ((w = v ∨ w = 0) ∧ Masked ws vs)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.Masked_zeros
statement: theorem Masked_zeros : ∀ r : List Int, Masked (zeros r) r
proof:
| []     => trivial
  | _ :: s => ⟨Or.inr rfl, Masked_zeros s⟩

name: LagTwoPositivity.Masked_refl
statement: theorem Masked_refl : ∀ r : List Int, Masked r r
proof:
| []     => trivial
  | _ :: s => ⟨Or.inl rfl, Masked_refl s⟩

name: LagTwoPositivity.Masked_nonneg
statement: theorem Masked_nonneg : ∀ {w u : List Int}, Masked w u → Nonneg u → Nonneg w
proof:
| [],      [],      _, _  => trivial
  | _ :: _,  [],      h, _  => absurd h (by simp [Masked])
  | [],      _ :: _,  h, _  => absurd h (by simp [Masked])
  | w :: ws, v :: vs, h, hu =>
      ⟨by have := hu.1; rcases h.1 with hh | hh <;> omega,
       Masked_nonneg h.2 hu.2⟩

name: LagTwoPositivity.restr_masked
statement: theorem restr_masked : ∀ {x : List Int}, ∀ B ∈ restr x, Masked B x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro B hB; simp at hB
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro B hB
    have hmap : ∀ (L : List (List Int)), (∀ C ∈ L, Masked C r) →
        ∀ C ∈ L.map (fun B => (0 : Int) :: B), Masked C (v :: r) := by
      intro L hL C hC
      rcases List.mem_map.1 hC with ⟨C', hC', rfl⟩
      exact ⟨Or.inr rfl, hL C' hC'⟩
    by_cases hv : 0 < v
    · by_cases hw : 0 < hd r
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_pos hv hw] at hB
        cases hb : restr r with
        | nil => exact absurd hb (restr_ne_nil hw)
        | cons H T =>
          rw [hb] at hB
          simp only [List.headD_cons, List.tail_cons, List.mem_cons] at hB
          rcases hB with rfl | hB
          · exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, ih H (by rw [hb]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩
          · exact hmap T (fun C hC => ih C (by rw [hb]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hC)) B hB
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_nonpos hv hw] at hB
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hB with rfl | hB
        · exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, Masked_zeros r⟩
        · exact hmap (restr r) (fun C hC => ih C hC) B hB
    · rw [restr_cons_nonpos hv] at hB
      exact hmap (restr r) (fun C hC => ih C hC) B hB

name: LagTwoPositivity.restr_nonneg
statement: theorem restr_nonneg {x : List Int} (hx : Nonneg x) : ∀ B ∈ restr x, Nonneg B
proof:
:=
  fun B hB => Masked_nonneg (restr_masked B hB) hx

name: LagTwoPositivity.restr_mem_pos
statement: theorem restr_mem_pos : ∀ {x : List Int}, ∀ B ∈ restr x, ∃ u ∈ B, 0 < u
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro B hB; simp at hB
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro B hB
    have hmap : ∀ (L : List (List Int)), (∀ C ∈ L, ∃ u ∈ C, 0 < u) →
        ∀ C ∈ L.map (fun B => (0 : Int) :: B), ∃ u ∈ C, 0 < u := by
      intro L hL C hC
      rcases List.mem_map.1 hC with ⟨C', hC', rfl⟩
      rcases hL C' hC' with ⟨u, hu, hup⟩
      exact ⟨u, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu, hup⟩
    by_cases hv : 0 < v
    · by_cases hw : 0 < hd r
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_pos hv hw] at hB
        cases hb : restr r with
        | nil => exact absurd hb (restr_ne_nil hw)
        | cons H T =>
          rw [hb] at hB
          simp only [List.headD_cons, List.tail_cons, List.mem_cons] at hB
          rcases hB with rfl | hB
          · exact ⟨v, List.mem_cons_self .., hv⟩
          · exact hmap T (fun C hC => ih C (by rw [hb]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hC)) B hB
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_nonpos hv hw] at hB
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hB with rfl | hB
        · exact ⟨v, List.mem_cons_self .., hv⟩
        · exact hmap (restr r) (fun C hC => ih C hC) B hB
    · rw [restr_cons_nonpos hv] at hB
      exact hmap (restr r) (fun C hC => ih C hC) B hB

name: LagTwoPositivity.masked_iff
statement: theorem masked_iff : ∀ w u : List Int, Masked w u ↔ maskedB w u = true
proof:
| [],      []      => Iff.intro (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => trivial)
  | [],      _ :: _  => Iff.intro (fun h => False.elim h) (fun h => Bool.noConfusion h)
  | _ :: _,  []      => Iff.intro (fun h => False.elim h) (fun h => Bool.noConfusion h)
  | w :: ws, v :: vs => by
      rw [Masked_cons, masked_iff ws vs]
      simp [maskedB]

name: LagTwoPositivity.sqnorm_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem sqnorm_nil : sqnorm [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.sqnorm_cons
statement: theorem sqnorm_cons {v : Int} {r : List Int} : sqnorm (v :: r) = v * v + sqnorm r
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.D_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem D_nil {d : Int → Int} : D d [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: LagTwoPositivity.D_cons
statement: theorem D_cons {d : Int → Int} {v : Int} {r : List Int} : D d (v :: r) = d v + D d r
proof:
:= by
  simp [D]

name: LagTwoPositivity.sqnorm_eq_D
statement: theorem sqnorm_eq_D : ∀ x : List Int, sqnorm x = D (fun t => t * t) x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v r ih => rw [sqnorm_cons, D_cons, ih]

name: LagTwoPositivity.D_id_eq_sum
statement: theorem D_id_eq_sum : ∀ x : List Int, D id x = x.sum
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v r ih => rw [D_cons, ih]; simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.blocks_mem_ne_nil
statement: theorem blocks_mem_ne_nil : ∀ {x : List Int}, ∀ B ∈ blocks x, B ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro B hB; simp at hB
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro B hB
    by_cases hv : 0 < v
    · by_cases hw : 0 < hd r
      · rw [blocks_cons_pos_pos hv hw] at hB
        cases hb : blocks r with
        | nil => exact absurd hb (blocks_ne_nil hw)
        | cons H T =>
          rw [hb] at hB
          simp only [List.headD_cons, List.tail_cons, List.mem_cons] at hB
          rcases hB with rfl | hB
          · simp
          · exact ih B (by rw [hb]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hB)
      · rw [blocks_cons_pos_nonpos hv hw] at hB
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hB with rfl | hB
        · simp
        · exact ih B hB
    · rw [blocks_cons_nonpos hv] at hB
      exact ih B hB

name: LagTwoPositivity.blocks_D_preserved
statement:
theorem blocks_D_preserved (d : Int → Int) (hd0 : d 0 = 0) :
    ∀ x : List Int, Nonneg x → ((blocks x).map (D d)).sum = D d x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro hx
    have hr : Nonneg r := nonneg_tail hx
    have IH := ih hr
    by_cases hv : 0 < v
    · by_cases hw : 0 < hd r
      · rw [blocks_cons_pos_pos hv hw]
        cases hb : blocks r with
        | nil => exact absurd hb (blocks_ne_nil hw)
        | cons H T =>
          rw [hb] at IH
          simp only [List.headD_cons, List.tail_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at IH ⊢
          rw [D_cons, D_cons]
          omega
      · rw [blocks_cons_pos_nonpos hv hw]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, D_cons, D_nil, Int.add_zero]
        omega
    · have hv0 : v = 0 := by have := hx.1; omega
      rw [blocks_cons_nonpos hv, D_cons, hv0, hd0]
      omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.blocks_sqnorm_preserved
statement:
theorem blocks_sqnorm_preserved (x : List Int) (hx : Nonneg x) :
    ((blocks x).map sqnorm).sum = sqnorm x
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : sqnorm = D (fun t => t * t) := funext sqnorm_eq_D
  rw [hfun]
  exact blocks_D_preserved (fun t => t * t) (by simp) x hx

name: LagTwoPositivity.sum_mul_le
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le {α : Type _} (f g : α → Int) (S T : Int) :
    ∀ l : List α, (∀ u ∈ l, T * g u ≤ f u * S) →
      T * ((l.map g).sum) ≤ ((l.map f).sum) * S
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons u t ih =>
    intro h
    have hu := h u (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have ht := ih (fun w hw => h w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw))
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Int.mul_add, Int.add_mul]
    omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.list_forall_or_exists
statement:
theorem list_forall_or_exists {α : Type _} (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    ∀ l : List α, (∀ u ∈ l, ¬ P u) ∨ (∃ u ∈ l, P u)
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => exact Or.inl (by simp)
  | cons u t ih =>
    by_cases h : P u
    · exact Or.inr ⟨u, List.mem_cons_self .., h⟩
    · rcases ih with ht | ⟨w, hw, hPw⟩
      · refine Or.inl ?_
        intro z hz
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hz with rfl | hz
        · exact h
        · exact ht z hz
      · exact Or.inr ⟨w, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw, hPw⟩

name: LagTwoPositivity.mul_lt_mul_right'
statement: theorem mul_lt_mul_right' {p q S : Int} (h : p < q) (hS : 0 < S) : p * S < q * S
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < (q - p) * S := Int.mul_pos (by omega) hS
  rw [Int.sub_mul] at hpos
  omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.sum_map_nonneg
statement:
theorem sum_map_nonneg {α : Type _} (f : α → Int) :
    ∀ l : List α, (∀ u ∈ l, 0 ≤ f u) → 0 ≤ (l.map f).sum
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons u t ih =>
    intro h
    have := ih (fun w hw => h w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw))
    have := h u (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.sum_map_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_map_eq_zero {α : Type _} (f : α → Int) :
    ∀ l : List α, (∀ u ∈ l, 0 ≤ f u) → (l.map f).sum = 0 → ∀ u ∈ l, f u = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ _ u hu; simp at hu
  | cons u t ih =>
    intro h hsum w hw
    have hnn := sum_map_nonneg f t (fun z hz => h z (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz))
    have hu := h u (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at hsum
    have hu0 : f u = 0 := by omega
    have ht0 : (t.map f).sum = 0 := by omega
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hw with rfl | hw
    · exact hu0
    · exact ih (fun z hz => h z (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz)) ht0 w hw

name: LagTwoPositivity.D_zeros
statement: @[simp] theorem D_zeros (hd0 : d 0 = 0) : ∀ r : List Int, D d (zeros r) = 0
proof:
| []     => rfl
  | _ :: s => by rw [zeros_cons, D_cons, hd0, D_zeros hd0 s]; simp

name: LagTwoPositivity.sum_map_D_cons_zero
statement:
theorem sum_map_D_cons_zero (hd0 : d 0 = 0) :
    ∀ L : List (List Int),
      ((L.map (fun B => (0 : Int) :: B)).map (D d)).sum = (L.map (D d)).sum
proof:
| []     => rfl
  | B :: T => by
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, D_cons, hd0, Int.zero_add]
      rw [sum_map_D_cons_zero hd0 T]

name: LagTwoPositivity.restr_D_preserved
statement:
theorem restr_D_preserved (d : Int → Int) (hd0 : d 0 = 0) :
    ∀ x : List Int, Nonneg x → ((restr x).map (D d)).sum = D d x
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons v r ih =>
    intro hx
    have hr : Nonneg r := nonneg_tail hx
    have IH := ih hr
    by_cases hv : 0 < v
    · by_cases hw : 0 < hd r
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_pos hv hw]
        cases hb : restr r with
        | nil => exact absurd hb (restr_ne_nil hw)
        | cons H T =>
          rw [hb] at IH
          simp only [List.headD_cons, List.tail_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at IH ⊢
          rw [D_cons, D_cons, sum_map_D_cons_zero hd0 T]
          omega
      · rw [restr_cons_pos_nonpos hv hw]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
        rw [D_cons, D_cons, D_zeros hd0, sum_map_D_cons_zero hd0 (restr r)]
        omega
    · have hv0 : v = 0 := by have := hx.1; omega
      rw [restr_cons_nonpos hv, D_cons, hv0, hd0,
        sum_map_D_cons_zero hd0 (restr r), Int.zero_add]
      exact IH

name: LagTwoPositivity.D_nonneg_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem D_nonneg_of_nonneg (hd0 : d 0 = 0) (hdpos : ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 < d t) :
    ∀ {B : List Int}, Nonneg B → 0 ≤ D d B
proof:
:= by
  intro B
  induction B with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons u t ih =>
    intro h
    have htail := ih h.2
    rw [D_cons]
    by_cases hu : 0 < u
    · have := hdpos u hu; omega
    · have : u = 0 := by have := h.1; omega
      rw [this, hd0]; omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.D_pos_of_mem_pos
statement:
theorem D_pos_of_mem_pos (hd0 : d 0 = 0) (hdpos : ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 < d t) :
    ∀ {B : List Int}, Nonneg B → (∃ u ∈ B, 0 < u) → 0 < D d B
proof:
:= by
  intro B
  induction B with
  | nil => intro _ h; rcases h with ⟨u, hu, -⟩; cases hu
  | cons u t ih =>
    intro h hex
    
    
    rcases hex with ⟨w, hw, hwp⟩
    have htail := D_nonneg_of_nonneg hd0 hdpos h.2
    rw [D_cons]
    by_cases hu : 0 < u
    · have := hdpos u hu; omega
    · have hu0 : u = 0 := by have := h.1; omega
      have hwt : w ∈ t := by
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hw with he | hw'
        · exfalso; rw [he, hu0] at hwp; omega
        · exact hw'
      have := ih h.2 ⟨w, hwt, hwp⟩
      rw [hu0, hd0]; omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.restr_D_pos
statement:
theorem restr_D_pos (hd0 : d 0 = 0) (hdpos : ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 < d t)
    {x : List Int} (hx : Nonneg x) : ∀ B ∈ restr x, 0 < D d B
proof:
:=
  fun B hB => D_pos_of_mem_pos hd0 hdpos (restr_nonneg hx B hB) (restr_mem_pos B hB)

name: LagTwoPositivity.isolated_zero_strict_posdep
statement:
theorem isolated_zero_strict_posdep (hband : Bandwidth c 2) (hc2 : ∀ i, 0 < c i 2)
    {x : List Int} (hx : Nonneg x) (hiso : 0 < iso x) :
    ((restr x).map (Qf c)).sum < Qf c x
proof:
:= by
  have hid := gd_identity_band_two hband x hx
  have hW : 0 < isoW c 0 x := isoW_pos hc2 x hx 0 hiso
  omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.rayleigh_transfer_posdep
statement:
theorem rayleigh_transfer_posdep (hband : Bandwidth c 2) (hc2 : ∀ i, 0 < c i 2)
    (d : Int → Int) (hd0 : d 0 = 0) (hdpos : ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 < d t)
    {x : List Int} (hx : Nonneg x) (hiso : 0 < iso x) (hDx : 0 < D d x) :
    ∃ B ∈ restr x, 0 < D d B ∧ Qf c B * D d x < Qf c x * D d B
proof:
:= by
  rcases list_forall_or_exists
      (fun B => 0 < D d B ∧ Qf c B * D d x < Qf c x * D d B) (restr x) with hall | hex
  · exfalso
    have hle : ∀ B ∈ restr x, Qf c x * D d B ≤ Qf c B * D d x := by
      intro B hB
      have hpos : 0 < D d B := restr_D_pos hd0 hdpos hx B hB
      have hnn : ¬ (Qf c B * D d x < Qf c x * D d B) := fun hlt => hall B hB ⟨hpos, hlt⟩
      omega
    have hsum := sum_mul_le (Qf c) (D d) (D d x) (Qf c x) (restr x) hle
    rw [restr_D_preserved d hd0 x hx] at hsum
    have hlt := isolated_zero_strict_posdep hband hc2 hx hiso
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_right' hlt hDx
    omega
  · exact hex

name: LagTwoPositivity.rayleigh_transfer_posdep_sum
statement:
theorem rayleigh_transfer_posdep_sum (hband : Bandwidth c 2) (hc2 : ∀ i, 0 < c i 2)
    {x : List Int} (hx : Nonneg x) (hiso : 0 < iso x) (hM : 0 < D id x) :
    ∃ B ∈ restr x, 0 < D id B ∧ Qf c B * D id x < Qf c x * D id B
proof:
:=
  rayleigh_transfer_posdep hband hc2 id rfl (fun _ ht => ht) hx hiso hM

name: LagTwoPositivity.restr_sqnorm_preserved
statement:
theorem restr_sqnorm_preserved (x : List Int) (hx : Nonneg x) :
    ((restr x).map sqnorm).sum = sqnorm x
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : sqnorm = D (fun t => t * t) := funext sqnorm_eq_D
  rw [hfun]
  exact restr_D_preserved (fun t => t * t) (by simp) x hx

name: LagTwoPositivity.blocks_restr_D_agree
statement:
theorem blocks_restr_D_agree (d : Int → Int) (hd0 : d 0 = 0) (x : List Int) (hx : Nonneg x) :
    ((blocks x).map (D d)).sum = ((restr x).map (D d)).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [blocks_D_preserved d hd0 x hx, restr_D_preserved d hd0 x hx]

name: LagTwoPositivity.rayleigh_transfer_sqnorm
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : sqnorm = D (fun t => t * t) := funext sqnorm_eq_D
  rw [hfun] at hS ⊢
  exact rayleigh_transfer_posdep hband hc2 (fun t => t * t) (by simp)
    (fun t ht => Int.mul_pos ht ht) hx hiso hS

name: LagTwoPositivity.rayleigh_transfer_toeplitz
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : Qf (toep a b c) = Q a b c := funext (Qf_toep a b c)
  have hc2 : ∀ i, 0 < toep a b c i 2 := fun i => by rw [toep_two]; exact hc
  have h := rayleigh_transfer_sqnorm (toep_band a b c) hc2 hx hiso hS
  rw [hfun] at h
  exact h

name: LagTwoPositivity.rayleigh_transfer_toeplitz_sum
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : Qf (toep a b c) = Q a b c := funext (Qf_toep a b c)
  have hdi : ∀ y : List Int, D id y = y.sum := D_id_eq_sum
  have hc2 : ∀ i, 0 < toep a b c i 2 := fun i => by rw [toep_two]; exact hc
  have hM' : 0 < D id x := by rw [hdi]; exact hM
  rcases rayleigh_transfer_posdep (toep_band a b c) hc2 id rfl (fun _ ht => ht) hx hiso hM'
    with ⟨B, hB, hpos, hlt⟩
  rw [hfun] at hlt
  simp only [hdi] at hpos hlt
  exact ⟨B, hB, hpos, hlt⟩

name: LagTwoPositivity.copositive_zero_iso
statement:
theorem copositive_zero_iso (hband : Bandwidth c 2) (hc2 : ∀ i, 0 < c i 2)
    (hcop : Copositive c) {u : List Int} (hu : IsZero c u) : iso u = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnn : 0 ≤ iso u := iso_nonneg u hu.nonneg
  by_cases hpos : 0 < iso u
  · exfalso
    have hW : 0 < isoW c 0 u := isoW_pos hc2 u hu.nonneg 0 hpos
    have hid := gd_identity_band_two hband u hu.nonneg
    rw [hu.vanishes] at hid
    have hblocks : 0 ≤ ((restr u).map (Qf c)).sum :=
      sum_map_nonneg (Qf c) (restr u) (fun B hB => hcop B (restr_nonneg hu.nonneg B hB))
    omega
  · omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.copositive_restr_isZero
statement:
theorem copositive_restr_isZero (hband : Bandwidth c 2) (hc2 : ∀ i, 0 < c i 2)
    (hcop : Copositive c) {u : List Int} (hu : IsZero c u) :
    ∀ B ∈ restr u, IsZero c B
proof:
:= by
  have hiso : iso u = 0 := copositive_zero_iso hband hc2 hcop hu
  have hW : isoW c 0 u = 0 := isoW_eq_zero_of_iso_eq_zero u hu.nonneg 0 hiso
  have hid := gd_identity_band_two hband u hu.nonneg
  rw [hu.vanishes, hW, Int.add_zero] at hid
  have hnn : ∀ B ∈ restr u, 0 ≤ Qf c B :=
    fun B hB => hcop B (restr_nonneg hu.nonneg B hB)
  have hzero := sum_map_eq_zero (Qf c) (restr u) hnn hid.symm
  exact fun B hB =>
    { nonneg := restr_nonneg hu.nonneg B hB
      nontrivial := restr_mem_pos B hB
      vanishes := hzero B hB }

name: LagTwoPositivity.copositive_minimalZero_isInterval
statement:
theorem copositive_minimalZero_isInterval (hband : Bandwidth c 2) (hc2 : ∀ i, 0 < c i 2)
    (hcop : Copositive c) {u : List Int} (hu : MinimalZero c u) : IsInterval u
proof:
:= by
  have hu0 := hu.1
  have hblocks := copositive_restr_isZero hband hc2 hcop hu0
  have hD := restr_D_preserved id rfl u hu0.nonneg
  by_cases hlen : (restr u).length ≤ 1
  · exact hlen
  · exfalso
    have h2 : 2 ≤ (restr u).length := by omega
    cases hb : restr u with
    | nil => rw [hb] at h2; simp at h2
    | cons B L =>
      cases hL : L with
      | nil => rw [hb, hL] at h2; simp at h2
      | cons C T =>
        have hBmem : B ∈ restr u := by rw [hb]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
        have hCmem : C ∈ restr u := by
          rw [hb, hL]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        
        have hBu : B = u := hu.2 B (restr_masked B hBmem) (hblocks B hBmem)
        
        have hCpos : 0 < D id C := restr_D_pos rfl (fun _ ht => ht) hu0.nonneg C hCmem
        have hTnn : 0 ≤ (T.map (D id)).sum :=
          sum_map_nonneg (D id) T (fun z hz =>
            have := restr_D_pos (d := id) rfl (fun _ ht => ht) hu0.nonneg z
              (by rw [hb, hL]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz))
            Int.le_of_lt this)
        rw [hb, hL] at hD
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at hD
        rw [hBu] at hD
        omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.allLists_spec
statement:
theorem allLists_spec : ∀ n : Nat, ∀ x ∈ allLists n,
    x.length = n ∧ Nonneg x ∧ ∀ v ∈ x, v ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro x hx
    have hnil : x = [] := by simpa [allLists] using hx
    subst hnil
    exact ⟨rfl, trivial, by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro x hx
    have heq : allLists (n + 1)
        = (allLists n).flatMap (fun l => [0, 1, 2, 3].map (fun v => v :: l)) := rfl
    rw [heq] at hx
    rcases List.mem_flatMap.1 hx with ⟨l, hl, hxl⟩
    rcases List.mem_map.1 hxl with ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hlen, hnn, hb⟩ := ih l hl
    have hv3 : 0 ≤ v ∧ v ≤ 3 := by
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hv
      rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide
    refine ⟨by simp [hlen], ⟨hv3.1, hnn⟩, ?_⟩
    intro w hw
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hw with rfl | hw
    · exact hv3.2
    · exact hb w hw

name: LagTwoPositivity.mem_allLists_cons
statement:
theorem mem_allLists_cons {n : Nat} {v : Int} {l : List Int}
    (hv : v ∈ ([0,1,2,3] : List Int)) (hl : l ∈ allLists n) : v :: l ∈ allLists (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  show v :: l ∈ (allLists n).flatMap (fun l => [0, 1, 2, 3].map (fun v => v :: l))
  exact List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨l, hl, List.mem_map.2 ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩⟩

name: LagTwoPositivity.alternating_mem_allLists
statement: theorem alternating_mem_allLists : ([3,0,3,0,3,0,3] : List Int) ∈ allLists 7
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ([] : List Int) ∈ allLists 0 := by decide
  exact mem_allLists_cons (by decide) (mem_allLists_cons (by decide)
    (mem_allLists_cons (by decide) (mem_allLists_cons (by decide)
      (mem_allLists_cons (by decide) (mem_allLists_cons (by decide)
        (mem_allLists_cons (by decide) h0))))))

name: LagTwoPositivity.defectStep_le
statement: theorem defectStep_le (acc : Int) (x : List Int) : defectStep acc x ≤ acc
proof:
:= by
  simp only [defectStep]
  by_cases h : 0 < iso x
  · rw [if_pos h]
    by_cases h' : defect x < acc
    · rw [if_pos h']; omega
    · rw [if_neg h']; omega
  · rw [if_neg h]; omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.defectStep_ge
statement:
theorem defectStep_ge {acc : Int} {x : List Int} (hacc : -2700 ≤ acc)
    (hx : -2700 ≤ defect x) : -2700 ≤ defectStep acc x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [defectStep]
  by_cases h : 0 < iso x
  · rw [if_pos h]
    by_cases h' : defect x < acc
    · rw [if_pos h']; omega
    · rw [if_neg h']; omega
  · rw [if_neg h]; omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.foldl_defectStep_le_acc
statement:
theorem foldl_defectStep_le_acc :
    ∀ (l : List (List Int)) (acc : Int), l.foldl defectStep acc ≤ acc
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; exact Int.le_refl acc
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro acc
    have h1 := ih (defectStep acc x)
    have h2 := defectStep_le acc x
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    omega

name: LagTwoPositivity.foldl_defectStep_ge
statement:
theorem foldl_defectStep_ge :
    ∀ (l : List (List Int)) (acc : Int), -2700 ≤ acc →
      (∀ x ∈ l, -2700 ≤ defect x) → -2700 ≤ l.foldl defectStep acc
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro acc hacc _; exact hacc
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro acc hacc hall
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    exact ih (defectStep acc x) (defectStep_ge hacc (hall x (List.mem_cons_self ..)))
      (fun z hz => hall z (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz))

name: LagTwoPositivity.foldl_defectStep_le
statement:
theorem foldl_defectStep_le :
    ∀ (l : List (List Int)) (acc : Int) (y : List Int), y ∈ l → 0 < iso y →
      l.foldl defectStep acc ≤ defect y
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ y hy _; simp at hy
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro acc y hy hiso
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hy with rfl | hy
    · have h1 := foldl_defectStep_le_acc t (defectStep acc y)
      have h2 : defectStep acc y ≤ defect y := by
        simp only [defectStep, if_pos hiso]
        by_cases h' : defect y < acc
        · rw [if_pos h']; omega
        · rw [if_neg h']; omega
      omega
    · exact ih (defectStep acc x) y hy hiso

name: LagTwoPositivity.defectMin_ge_neg_2700
statement: theorem defectMin_ge_neg_2700 (n : Nat) (hn : n ≤ 7) : -2700 ≤ defectMin n
proof:
:=
  foldl_defectStep_ge (allLists n) 0 (by omega) (fun x hx =>
    have h := allLists_spec n x hx
    defect_ge_neg_2700 x h.2.1 h.2.2 (by omega))

name: LagTwoPositivity.defectMin_eq_neg_2700
statement: theorem defectMin_eq_neg_2700 : defectMin 7 = -2700
proof:
:= by
  have hge := defectMin_ge_neg_2700 7 (by omega)
  have hle : defectMin 7 ≤ defect [3,0,3,0,3,0,3] :=
    foldl_defectStep_le (allLists 7) 0 [3,0,3,0,3,0,3] alternating_mem_allLists (by decide)
  rw [defect_attained.2.2.2.2] at hle
  omega
